title: Action on an embedded configuration
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota$ embed the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and choose arbitrary initial contents and head positions for the $k$ tapes, an output prefix, an initial configuration on $m$ tapes, and a one-step action on those tapes. Applying the action after embedding the configuration—with output emitted on the output tape—gives the same configuration as first applying the action to the original configuration and then embedding the result with the same initial contents, head positions, and output prefix.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Initial contents for each of the $k$ tapes
Initial head positions for each of the $k$ tapes
